author: Arbittrary
text:
🛶 Post-Plinko Kayaking Trip: Monday 10/19

Since Plinko is Sat and Sun in Orlando, a few of us are going kayaking Monday the 19th at King’s Landing in Apopka (about 30 min from Orlando). It’s a self-guided paddle on Rock Springs Run, crystal clear spring water, looks super chill.

⚠️ Book your spot online ahead of time. They only hold a couple kayaks for walk-ins and they sell out, so don’t plan on just showing up.

How to book:

Go here: https://www.kingslandingfl.com/daypaddlekayakrentals
Hit Book Now
Pick Monday, Oct 19 and the time slot we agree on (see below)

Prices (4 hour rental):

Single kayak: $54
Double kayak (2 people): $74
Paddleboard: $74
Canoe (3 people): $64
Locker: $10 (optional)

Double kayaks and canoes are cheaper per person if you split with someone, so pair up if you want.

Good to know:

They close at 5pm and anything booked after 1pm won’t get the full 4 hours, so we should go earlier in the day
Return shuttle isn’t included, it’s a paddle out and back to the launch

What time works for you? React below:
🌅 Morning (8:30 to 10)
☀️ Late morning (10 to 12)
🕐 Early afternoon (12 to 1)

(we should probably do the late morning one)

Drop a ✅ if you’re coming so we know headcount.

author: shaamad
text:
🌐 GLOBAL ANNOUNCEMENTS

📢 CYBER CLUB — THIS WEEK 🦉🔐

Busy, fun week ahead — meetings both nights, two competitions, and a practice image to grab tonight. Read through 👇

🪟 TONIGHT — Tuesday Meeting | 5–7 PM | CM 22, Rm 125 (behind the library)
Marcos is running a Windows session, walking through the built-in Windows tools he actually used in competition — Event Viewer, Task Manager, netstat, Local Users & Groups, Defender, and the Windows Firewall. We’ll pull it up live from our practice environment so you can see exactly how it looks in a real defensive scenario. Whether you’ve never touched this stuff or you’re comp-rostered, come hang and get hands-on.

💻 GRAB THE PRACTICE IMAGE — BEFORE TONIGHT
We’re practicing on the Cincinnati Zoo image (Windows 10) so you can follow Marcos step by step.
📥 Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ai3vff_pS_rABc8hsnE_0uv08MOZiB1W/view
📋 Full image list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cdVHtk4w5JDJCYy-EO2_ycr0ZqMgUyjFOVDn5Y8eGVw/edit?gid=0#gid=0
Setup: download → unzip → double-click the .vmx to open it in VMware (install Workstation Player/Pro, or Fusion on Mac, first). If it won’t launch: VMware → Open a Virtual Machine → pick the .vmx. Ping the chat if it won’t boot and we’ll fix it before the meeting.

🎯 Thursday Meeting | 5–7 PM | CM 22, Rm 125 — HORSE PLINKO PRACTICE LAB
Scheduling note: Zach Bright’s talk moved to Oct 27, so Thursday is now a hands-on Plinko prep lab. We’ll run practice images, cover scripting basics, and — since our WRCCDC env with the scoring engine is live — I’ll stage a real attack so you can watch defense happen in real time. Easily one of our most useful sessions. Come even if you’re not competing — this is how you actually learn it.

🏆 TWO COMPETITIONS — big opportunities:

Horse Plinko (HPCC4) — this weekend @ UCF. Beginner-friendly cyber defense comp. Great first competition if you’ve been wanting to try one.
UBlockdown — defensive comp, run right here in our lab room, 6-person teams, and I want two teams. 👇

🚨 URGENT — UBLOCKDOWN SIGNUPS CLOSE FRIDAY 🚨
If you want in, you MUST sign up by Friday — competition is Sat Oct 24. Spots are limited to two 6-person teams, so drop your name / DM me ASAP. Don’t sit on this — once it’s full, it’s full. Even if you’re doing Plinko, do this one too.

👉 All prep and environment details, are in the competition chat — head there if you’re competing (or even thinking about it).

📅 Speaker lineup: Zachary Bright (ADT) → Oct 27 · Kyle Ryan (Red Team Mgr, NextEra) & Delia Drumm (Microsoft) later this month. 

Questions? Drop them here or DM me. Let’s have a great week 🔥

So — worth doing anyway, or save our energy for the others? Drop your vote/thoughts below! 👇 If enough people are down, we'll make it happen.
